patch_description: Restructure the solver into a pipeline of modular stages: (1) multi-restart randomized greedy construction, (2) ruin-and-recreate perturbation (remove k random transactions, greedily reinsert at best position), (3) adjacent-swap descent, all running under a unified time budget. This architecture escapes local optima that pure greedy+swap cannot, per the recommendation, and should lower makespan further.
